disposition_reason: ED-16 prohibits assuming an address is mirrored. PASS requires a project TAD/sa2da proof for the exact address, target B2CMI correction/mirror-scrub fields and a correlated extlog event after one UCE; generic UCE logs do not validate partial-mirror coverage.

test_case.test_name: GNR one-shot UCE inside a mapped10% mirrored range
test_case.purpose: Prove a UCE inside the configured partial-mirror range is corrected by the intended B2CMI path, scrubbed and firmware-logged.
required_package: Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies the10% ARM/TAD range and maps0x100000300 to B2CMI1, captures baseline, performs one UCE, collects corrected/mirror-scrub B2CMI evidence, executes go once, correlates extlog_mem_event, verifies health and restores settings.
test_case.expected_result: The exact in-range UCE is corrected and scrubbed by mapped B2CMI1, a matching extlog event appears, resume is healthy and settings return to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable range/address/B2CMI mapping, one UCE, decoded correction/scrub and extlog correlation, healthy go and restoration. Out-of-range/wrong bank/severity, missing evidence or recovery failure fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Explicit UCE authorization on isolated SUT.
Do not inject until exact address is proven inside mirrored range.
Preserve baseline; clear only approved volatile target state.
One injection/go only; no automatic retry or reboot.
test_case.recovery: On wrong-range attribution, fatal escape or hang, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery without reinjection; restore ARM/TAD/patrol/debug settings and validate memory health.
